# IS1200 Lab 4 - Assignment 2 RegisterFile test vector
# Inputs: CLK WE3 A1[3] A2[3] A3[3] WD3[32]
# Outputs: RD1[32] RD2[32] T2[32]
# Sequential test: same <set>, increasing <seq>.
# <DC> = don't care.

CLK WE3 A1[3] A2[3] A3[3] WD3[32] RD1[32] RD2[32] T2[32] <set> <seq>

0 0 000 000 000 0x00000000 0x00000000 0x00000000 0x00000000 1 1
